consumer_contract: Records store AttemptResult.UserHash.Hex() with AppName and Anonymous, and never add a raw user column
Per-user limits, loop state and cache key on the pair of app and hash, plus the anonymous flag
Limit refusals, budget headers and degradation events carry configuration paths and categories, never a user hash or identifier
Search and deletion call LookupHash for each app in history, including removed apps, and pick anonymous explicitly
A storage-backed HistoryGuard replaces the filesystem guard before the database is created, and its reset keeps spending totals
Each channel above moves to covered when it exists, in the same change, and the suite then requires it
